name: BOUNCE UP - Berlin's New Pulse of the Caribbean
description: BOUNCE UP marks the launch of a new Berlin party series at ACUD Club, bringing dancehall, basshall and urban club sounds to the dancefloor with plenty of energy. Behind the format are familiar names from the scene, such as Massive Vibes, Silent Pressure and Jabstar, who have been shaping Berlin's nights for years. The kick-off features Hille from the Soundquake Soundsystem, together with other acts bringing the latest tunes, classics and Caribbean vibes.
